layouts.name: Bucks_Estate_Circuit
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The supplied road-course configuration identifies Osier Way, the southern A421 roundabout return, the bypass to the Great Slade hook, Middle Slade and Top Angel. Council planning material independently identifies the Buckingham industrial estate, Top Angel and Osier Way road network. Exact current public OSM road nodes locate the connected route. The complete independently measured 1,694.2 m retains its 83.2 m difference from the supplied 1,611 m; historical road realignments and lane placement remain draft. The Lenborough Road alternative belongs to the separate Combo selection; estate parking aisles and dead-end access spurs are excluded. No coordinates are moved to the supplied layout image, length or timing data. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1694.2 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
